title: Separate stablecoin reserve income, distribution payments, equity stakes and XRP capital flows

decisions.rule: Store historical ownership percentages with an explicit as-of date; do not carry an IPO cap-table percentage forward as current ownership without a current filing.
Separate reserve income, issuer retention, distributor payments and third-party incentives. A distribution payment is an expense/revenue transfer, not new capital entering an underlying crypto asset.
Store issuer rate sensitivities as conditional scenarios with assumptions; never treat them as market forecasts.
Do not combine Coinbase average USDC held in products with point-in-time USDC Assets on Platform until definitions and scope are reconciled.
Do not infer XRP demand from USDC distribution revenue, Circle reserve income, Coinbase equity value or stablecoin circulation without a measured XRP transaction or collateral path.
